content: Histtiko Ayhuda as gideththas aaza go7ay dizee? Qaxxaray ay go7izee?
Awarakka gidiin go7ay daro; harappe koyro Xoossa qaalay hadara Ayhudatas imettides.
Isttafe issotas issotas ammanoy baynda aggiko Xoossan ammaneteth diggizee?
Mulekka diggenna! Asi wurikka wordanchcha,

Nu makkalla oosoy Xoossa xilloteth qonccen bessizayssa gidikko histtiin nu ay gaanee? Coo asa woga mala palamettanaas Xoossi ba hanqo nu bolla ehizayssi nuus bessenna gaaneyee? Hessaka ta gizay asaththo qofanna.
Tumappe hessaththo hanenna; hessaththo hanizaa gidikko Xoossi alame bolla wostti pirdandee?
«Ta wordoteththi Xoossa tumateth qonccisizayssan iza bonchcho gede gujjizaa gidikko histtiin ha7i gakkanaas wostti ta bolla nagaranchcha mala pirdettizee?» giidi palamettana asi daana dandayees.
Hessa guussi, «Lo7oy yaana mala ane iita ooththoos» geettes giidi issi issi asati nu bolla woresizayssa mala. Hayta asata bolla gakkiza pirday tumu pirda.
Asi Wuri Nagaranchcha
Histtiin nu ay giinoo? Nuni isttafe aadhdhizonii? Mulekka aadhdhoko. Ayhudata gidikkoka, Ayzaabeta gidikkoka wurikka nagarappe garsa baggara diza gishshas ta wursaka kasetada isttas yootadis.

content.text: Istta doonay doya diza duufo mala;

content: geetetti xaafettida mala.
Hessa gishshas doonay wurikka gordettana mala derey kumeth Xoossas zaaro immana mala wogay gizay wurikka wogappe giddora dizaytas gididayssa nu eroos.
Hessa gishshas wogay nagaray aazakko erisees attiin wogaa naagon oonikka iza achchan xillo geetettanaas dandayenna.
Ammanon Beettiza Xilloteth
Ha7i qasse kase nabeti izas markkattidayssi wogaappe karera gidida Xoossa xilloteththi qonccides.
Hessi Xoossa xilloteththi Yesus Kirstoosa ammanon dummateththi baynda beettiza xilloteththa.
Gaasoykka asi wurikka nagara ooththides; Xoossa bonchchoyka asa naas paccides.
Asay Yesus Kirstoosi asa naa gishshas ooththida kiyateththafe dendidayssan coo mela xillides.
Iza suuththan gidida ammanon nagarappe maarettana yarsho histtidi Xoossi Yesusa shiishshides; izi hessa ooththiday kasetidi polettida nagara qaxxayontta dandayan aadhdhida ba xilloteth bessanaassa.
Izi hessa ha wodezan ooththiday ba xilloteththaa; hessika ba baggara xillo gidida Yesus Kirstoosan ammanizaade xillisizayssa bessanaassa.
Histtiin nuni izan ceeqettiza miishshi aazi dizee? Aykko miishshankka ceeqettoko; nu ceeqettana gaasoykka aazee? Wogaa naagiza gishee? Gidenna; ammanonna.
Ay asikka ammanon attiin wogaa naagon attonttayssa nu geeshshi yootoos.
Xoossi Ayhudatas xallaa? Ayzaabetaska Xoos gidennee? Ee Ayzaabetaska izi Xoossa.
Qaxxarettidayssa ammanon qasse qaxxarettonttayssaka he ammanonkka xillisizaykka izi issi Xoossaa xalla.
Histtiin hessi hessa gidikko ammano gaason wogaa go7ay baynda miish ooththinoo? Mulekka hessaththo hanenna; Wogaa nu minththana attiin.
